package.description: Add two-factor authentication to Remote Desktop and local logons and credentialed UAC elevation prompts.

en-US.description: Add two-factor authentication to Remote Desktop and local logons and credentialed UAC elevation prompts.
en-US.longDescription:
Duo Authentication for Windows Logon adds Duo two-factor authentication to these Windows and Windows Server logon scenarios:
- Local or domain account logins
- Logins at the local console and/or incoming Remote Desktop (RDP) connections
- Credentialed User Access Control (UAC) elevation requests (e.g. Right-click + "Run as administrator") in v4.1.0 and later
Duo's Windows Logon client does not add a secondary authentication prompt to the following logon types:
- Shift + right-click "Run as different user"
- PowerShell "Enter-PSSession" or "Invoke-Command" cmdlets
- Non-interactive logons (i.e. Log on as a Service, Log on as Batch, Scheduled Tasks, drive mappings, etc.)
- Pre-Logon Access Providers (PLAPs) such as Windows Always On VPN
- RDP Restricted Admin Mode
en-US.name: Duo Authentication for Windows Logon

zh-CN.description: 为远程桌面和本地登录以及带凭据的 UAC 提权提示添加双重身份验证。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Duo Authentication for Windows Logon 将 Duo 双因素身份验证添加到以下 Windows 和 Windows Server 登录场景中：
- 本地或域账户登录
- 本地控制台登录和/或传入的远程桌面（RDP）连接
- 使用凭证的用户访问控制（UAC）提权请求（例如，右键单击 + “以管理员身份运行”），在 v4.1.0 及更高版本中支持
Duo 的 Windows 登录客户端不会为以下登录类型添加二次身份验证提示：
- 按住 Shift 键并右键单击“以其他用户身份运行”
- PowerShell 的 “Enter-PSSession” 或 “Invoke-Command” 命令
- 非交互式登录（例如，以服务身份登录、以批处理身份登录、计划任务、驱动器映射等）
- 登录前访问提供程序（PLAP），例如 Windows 始终连接的 VPN
- RDP 受限管理模式
